request:
Which modules of the click library (src/click/) import from both src/click/_compat.py and src/click/utils.py but do not import from src/click/core.py at all? Count every import statement, including imports inside functions and under type-checking guards. Give the repository-relative file path.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: Uses code.file_dependencies to find files under src/click/ that import both _compat.py and utils.py, then excludes any that import core.py. Each internal import statement is represented in the dependency view, so all import sites count.
sql: WITH deps AS (SELECT importer_file_id, imported_file_id, imported_names FROM code.file_dependencies) SELECT DISTINCT importer_file_id AS file_path FROM deps WHERE importer_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND importer_file_id IN (SELECT importer_file_id FROM deps WHERE imported_file_id = 'src/click/_compat.py') AND importer_file_id IN (SELECT importer_file_id FROM deps WHERE imported_file_id = 'src/click/utils.py') AND importer_file_id NOT IN (SELECT importer_file_id FROM deps WHERE imported_file_id = 'src/click/core.py') ORDER BY file_path
